title: WHAT WILL YOU DO WITH CHRIST
theme: Our response to Jesus determines acceptance before God, sonship, peace, joy, and eternal life; we must receive or reject the King, Son of God, and Savior.
proposition: If we do the right thing with Jesus, we get everything that is worth having for time and eternity; if we do the wrong thing with Jesus, we lose everything that is worth having for time and for eternity.
sermonQuestion: What will you do with Jesus?

outline.heading: WHAT DEPENDS UPON WHAT WE DO WITH JESUS.
